browser_smoke: Create a custom workspace and Run analysis.
Click Focus primary risk. Confirm a target picker appears instead of silently choosing one.
Choose one target. Confirm only that target becomes selected/focused and map + inspector open.
Confirm Propose repair was disabled before selection and is enabled after selection.
Click Propose repair. Confirm inspector says Repair requested and audit gets FOCUS / PROPOSE_REPAIR.
Without an external agent, use Write repair manually and create a proposal. Confirm the proposal appears with Use suggestion / Edit first / Keep current / Decide later.
Before reviewing the first proposal, click Focus another risk, select a second target, and create/request a second proposal.
Confirm two distinct proposal cards can exist at the same time.
Review one proposal and confirm the other remains PROPOSED.
With a WebMCP agent, call propose_revision for two distinct targets and confirm both appear in the Human decision queue.
